title: Feature Request: Enable the AAPS Widget for the secondary screen on the Samsung Galaxy Flip Z 3
symptom: The Galaxy Flip Z 3 has a secondary display on the outside that can show certain widgets like a clock, agenda, etc. It would be great to be able to show the standard AAPS widget that is available on the start screen also on the secondary display, so the phone doesn't need to be opened to check the widget information.
fix: Use the Android app 'Coverscreen OS' to show the android widget on the Cover Screen.
evidence_quote: With the Android app "[Coverscreen OS](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=apps.ijp.coveros&hl=nl&gl=US)" it is possible to show the android widget also on the Cover Screen.
